links.outcome: Clinician appraisal of appropriateness of AI conversation summaries from real user interaction transcripts
links.effect: HCPs reviewed transcripts of CM tool interactions and found the conversational summaries clinically appropriate, informative and beneficial for supporting linkage to HIV care.
links.quote: HCPs found the conversational summaries clinically appropriate, and cited the tool as informative and beneficial for supporting linkage to HIV care.

links.outcome: Usability (SUS) and acceptability among representative end users during simulated pilot use
links.effect: Mean SUS 81.6 (SD 17.5); 83.7% found it easy to use; 94.9% willing to use again; 91.0% reported positive influence on intention to access HIV services.
links.quote: The tool demonstrated high usability, with a mean SUS score of 81.6 (SD 17.5).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of the usability, acceptability, and clinical appropriateness of an AI-powered conversational tool ('Your Path') for guiding patients post-HIV self-testing using simulated sessions with community members and healthcare provider reviews.
